product.industry: Private aviation charter and aircraft operations
product.audience: Executive assistants, family-office travel teams and principals arranging time-critical point-to-point flights
product.decision: Which aircraft and operating plan responsibly fit a real route, party and schedule priority
product.conversion: Clear a flight dossier and submit a complete charter enquiry

signature.moment: A tactile 3D route globe orbits between operating points, then resolves route, party, range and priority into a cleared aircraft dossier

systems.hero: A daylight dispatch table with a cropped aircraft portrait, live route line and dossier status—not a cinematic scroll scene
systems.navigation: Compact operations header with local-time strip and direct anchors; no menu overlay
systems.contentDensity: Precise operational data at the decision points, relieved by two cinematic aviation frames and quiet service statements
systems.geometry: Airway lines, rectangular flight strips, perforated boarding-wallet edges, monospace stamps and asymmetrical dispatch columns
systems.motion: Demand-rendered 3D globe rotations and route-arc changes caused only by explicit controls; no autoplay or scroll choreography
systems.coreInteraction: Visitors rotate a spatial route globe, select an arrival, then use origin, party, range and priority to produce an enquiry-ready dossier

structuralDifferences: A compact boarding-pass route summary leads before the brand statement
The globe becomes a tall boarding-wallet world view with thumb-reachable east and west controls
Dispatch choices reveal one operational field at a time rather than the desktop table
The result collapses into a tear-off wallet with recommendation and clearance status
Fleet comparison becomes a selected aircraft specification strip with previous and next controls

artDirection.typography: Humanist system sans for service language, narrow grotesk for route codes and monospaced operational data; no external fonts
artDirection.material: Warm flight-paper surface, carbon text, aviation-blue route ink and safety-orange clearance marks
artDirection.imageLogic: Two original local daylight aviation photographs establish exterior and cabin truth; CSS renders the route plot, flight strips and boarding wallet
artDirection.microcopy: Block time, range reserve, baggage profile, operating window, dispatch, crew duty and handling language
artDirection.dataHonesty: All routes, timings, aircraft availability and pricing context are labelled illustrative and subject to operator confirmation

interactions.name: Interactive route globe

interactions.stateChange: 3D route arc, endpoint light, corridor code and globe heading update
interactions.visibleResult: A spatial mission route resolves before the aircraft recommendation workflow

interactions.input: Choose origin, destination, party size, operating range and schedule priority
interactions.stateChange: Route display, estimated block time, range context and recommended fleet update
interactions.visibleResult: A cleared boarding-wallet dossier naming the recommended aircraft and operational caveat

interactions.stateChange: Range, passengers, baggage and cabin role update

assetStrategy: Two original local photographs have non-interchangeable roles: one aircraft exterior defines dispatch and fleet scale; one cabin frame proves interior service character.

assets.role: Hero and fleet-scale portrait of a contemporary unbranded long-range jet
assets.focalCrop: Wide side-three-quarter aircraft with open tarmac on left
assets.mobileSafeArea: Nose, front door and wing root remain in central 70 percent

assets.role: Cabin protocol evidence showing a quiet daylight working environment
assets.focalCrop: Long cabin perspective with aisle centered and seat details on both sides
assets.mobileSafeArea: Aisle and two forward seats remain in central portrait crop

adjacentTemplates.why: This uses an immediate dispatch table and resolved route dossier, not the shared three-scene sticky travel story or enquiry drawer.
Operational route fields, fleet range and boarding-wallet output replace resort portals, room selections and cinematic scroll scenes.
There is no moving portal, room gallery or booking overlay; the core silhouette is a dispatch plot and perforated flight strip.
Although both assemble briefs, this dossier calculates a route-to-aircraft operational match and mobile boarding wallet rather than a clinical care passport.
No monitor, film rail, compositing frame or creative treatment; aviation uses map coordinates, aircraft specifications and clearance logic.

avoid: Claims of guaranteed aircraft or operational approval
